sections.title: Ethical Questions
sections.description: This course examines some of the central theoretical and practical questions of ethics. For example, what is the good life? By what measure or principles do we evaluate the rightness and wrongness of actions? How does ethical reasoning help us understand and address real world problems such as world hunger, social injustice, sex and race discrimination, climate change, and war.
